stages.note: Story trophies unlock automatically as you finish each chapter and mission. Scan vehicles and study animals as you go — that progress counts toward 100% later. Before Chapter 1 ends, meditate at the first spot at Jason's house: it is the one spot that becomes unavailable.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 5

stages.note: Finish the mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, then work through stranger missions until 8 strands are complete. Only some side questlines count toward the eight. Bret's animal hunt belongs here too.
stages.title: Side characters and strangers

stages.note: The checklist opens after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. It is lenient — about 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, and 70 of 80 challenges. Shooting Ranges, Drone Races, Robberies, Underwater Discoveries and Bret's quests need everything.
stages.title: The 100% checklist

stages.note: Cards, WAiNK spots, garage properties and the remaining meditation spots. These are pure exploration — sweep each area methodically and check your collection lists for what is missing.
stages.title: Collectibles and quiet moments

stages.note: Races, fishing, arcade, combat, robberies, money and the odd one-off moments. Finish the money trophies last — laundering and spending come naturally once the robberies are done. The platinum pops when the last of these is earned.
stages.title: Combat, robberies and cleanup

summary: About 200 hours, one playthrough, no difficulty settings. Story first, then side characters, then the 100% checklist, then collectibles and cleanup. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so do the one missable meditation in Chapter 1.
title: Platinum roadmap
